Nelson Sivisstum
Junior Full Stack Developer
Formosa, Argentina · Open to remote work · +54 11 7062-5896
nelsonsivisstum3@gmail.com
GitHub: github.com/nelsonvis3 · LinkedIn · Portfolio: nelsonsivisstum.vercel.app

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Junior Full Stack Developer with projects built using React, Next.js, TypeScript and Django. Implemented REST
APIs, authentication, company-level permissions, and inventory and payment workflows backed by PostgreSQL.
Looking for my first role on a development team, contributing to web applications and learning through code review.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
Backend and data: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, SQL
Testing and tools: Playwright, Django testing, GitHub Actions, Docker Compose, Git, Linux

FEATURED PROJECTS

Fracxion · Multi-tenant business management
2026 · Personal project · Individual development
Next.js, TypeScript, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL
github.com/nelsonvis3/fracxion-facturador
   Built customer, catalog, internal invoicing and payment modules with tenant data isolation and role-based
   permissions.
   Used PostgreSQL transactions and row-level locks to protect per-company invoice numbering and balances
   during concurrent operations.
   Automated permission and browser-flow tests with Django, Playwright and GitHub Actions.
Ragnar Suplementos · E-commerce store
2026 · Commissioned by a local business · Pre-launch demo
Next.js, React, TypeScript, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL
github.com/nelsonvis3/ragnarsuplementosfsa
   Built the storefront and catalog admin panel, with pricing, inventory and orders managed by a Django REST
   Framework API.
   Integrated Mercado Pago with server-side payment verification and stock reservations for products and bundles.
   Deployed a demo on Ubuntu Server with Docker Compose, Nginx and public HTTPS access through Tailscale
   Funnel.
RoadLedger · Trip-planning prototype
2026 · Technical assessment · Individual development
React, Django REST Framework, MapLibre, Photon and OSRM
github.com/nelsonvis3/ELD-trip-planner
   Built an educational prototype showing routes, a timeline and printable daily logs based on estimated driving and
   rest periods.
   Integrated Photon and OSRM for geocoding and routing, with 12 tests covering validation, the API contract and
   events crossing midnight.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
CS50's Web Programming with Python and JavaScript — HarvardX / edX · In progress
Full Stack JavaScript — The Odin Project · In progress
Front End Development Libraries — freeCodeCamp · Certified, August 2026
High School Diploma — E.P.E.P. No. 179, Formosa · 2023

LANGUAGES

Spanish: native · English: intermediate (B1)
